name: Decora
garments: dozens of plastic hair clips and accessories worn at once

media.title: FRUiTS magazine (1997–2017)
media.note: the main print record of the look's street-fashion era

reacts_against: minimalism entirely, piling on as many colorful accessories as physically possible.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Excessive layering of accessories (particularly hair clips), face stickers (plasters), bright primary colors, plastic toys, child-like motifs, layered socks, tutus, surgical masks
wiki_facts.key_colours:
Rainbow palette (all bright/neon primary colors)
Pink, yellow, blue, 
black (for Dark Decora), pastel rainbow palette
